title: Concept: Dependency resolved from a local path
description: package.json declares a `file:` dependency that points at a path on the build machine, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The installed code is whatever sits at that path at build time, so the artifact is not reproducible from the manifest and a local edit ships without review.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The installed code is whatever sits at that path at build time, so the artifact is not reproducible from the manifest and a local edit ships without review.
